# sherpa-metric

A KPI tile with an optional embedded sparkline.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | content |
| Wraps | [sherpa-data-viz-header](sherpa-data-viz-header.md) |
| Figma | Metric |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-metric/sherpa-metric.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-metric/sherpa-metric.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-metric/sherpa-metric.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-metric/sherpa-metric.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-metric/sherpa-metric.example.json) |

## When to use it

For a KPI tile: a headline number, its change and its trend, with an optional sparkline. For one value against zones on a scale, use `sherpa-gauge-chart`; for a trend line alone, use `sherpa-sparkline`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-metric data-label="Revenue"></sherpa-metric>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-metric`:

```json
{
  "label": "Revenue",
  "value": "$1.2M",
  "deltaPercent": 12.5
}
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-aggregate` | `count` `sum` `mean` `min` `max` `distinct` |  | ASKED of its provider: count \| sum \| mean \| min \| max \| distinct |
| `data-bands` | text |  |  |
| `data-bucket` | `day` `month` `year` |  | a date over-field, cut to day \| month \| year |
| `data-delta` | text |  | the change text (e.g. "+12.5%") |
| `data-field` | text |  | the number that aggregate reads |
| `data-format` | text |  | the value's Intl.NumberFormatOptions, as JSON |
| `data-has-values` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-icon` | text |  | a glyph before the name |
| `data-label` | text |  | the metric name, in its header above the value |
| `data-over-field` | text |  | the sparkline runs over this field |
| `data-segment-field` | text |  |  |
| `data-status` | `success` `critical` |  |  |
| `data-trend` | `up` `down` `flat` |  | up \| down \| flat (colours the delta + shows the arrow) |
| `data-value` | text |  | the formatted value string (big number) |
| `data-where` | text |  | its OWN default filter, a condition by field as JSON; narrows this tile alone |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number \| undefined` | read and write |  |
| `series` | `readonly number[]` | read only |  |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`delta`, `header`, `spark`, `trend`, `value`
